secret.label: Murder
secret.description: Ilse Lindemann is at the victim’s suite at the residential hotel from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM, alone with Isaiah Ashby when it happens at 10:30 PM.

motive.description: was about to be exposed by the victim

people.name: Prescott Fairbanks

secret.label: Gambling debt
secret.description: Prescott Fairbanks slips off to Kaplan’s drugstore with the soda fountain from 10:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

motive.description: blamed the victim for a ruin

secret.label: Fencing stolen goods

secret.label: Gambling debt
secret.description: Thaddeus Winslow slips off to Kaplan’s drugstore with the soda fountain from 10:00 PM to 10:30 PM to settle with a bookmaker.

secret.label: Blackmailing the victim

secret.label: Drinking in secret

Isaiah Ashby was found at the victim’s suite at the residential hotel. A glass is on its side and the spill had not yet reached the edge of the table when it dried. The El going over came at 10:30 PM, and the El was running to timetable and it covers the half hour exactly. That puts the killing in that half hour and no later.
The coroner puts death between 10:00 PM and 11:30 PM — two hours of nothing useful. Chloral hydrate in the stomach. No wound, no bruising, no sign of a struggle.
